reading.body:
Jasmine Crockett's AI record is legislative and environmental, not fiscal: five of her thirteen tracked events are AI or AI-adjacent bills, and the money attached to her is small.

The bills she cosponsored cover advertising disclosure, AI's environmental impacts, and model documentation, plus a resolution demanding records on DOGE's use of AI. Two of those, the AI Environmental Impacts Act and the Ratepayer Bill of Rights Act, sit directly on the power and cost side of the buildout, which is where the grid constraint on AI eventually lands in Congress. Her recorded votes in this set are sparse and mixed, one Yea, one Nay, one absence, so the data does not support a claim about a consistent voting posture.

The Meta PAC entries are four lines totaling $1,000, two contributions and two reversals of $500 each, filed in March and August 2025. That is a small sum and the reversals mean the net is not simply the gross. The data covers only what this site holds for one member, and it does not say what any bill became, what the votes were about beyond their titles, or why the contributions were reversed.

summary: Every dated AI event this site holds for Jasmine Crockett: bills sponsored or cosponsored, recorded votes on AI bills, and money from AI company and AI-focused political committees, newest first. 13 events.
